Situation Brief — Day 27

  • Active: Houthis launched two missiles and one UAV toward Israel. All intercepted. Houthi UAV also shot down over Eilat.
  • Air & air-defense events: IRGC reports shooting down a US MQ-9 Reaper over Shiraz (possible Majid SHORAD). CENTCOM reports >11,000 combat flights, >11,000 targets struck, >150 vessels damaged/destroyed.
  • Strikes on Iran (today): IAF struck and destroyed Tehran’s Natural Resources & Watershed Management Organization. Heavy attacks reported on Mehrabad Airport and a central Tehran strike killed ≥5, 25 trapped. An IRGC research facility was reported obliterated. Emirates Global Aluminium suffered significant damage.
  • Northern border / Lebanon: Hezbollah continues daily activity. Hezbollah hit an IDF Merkava tank in Debel with an Iranian-made ALMAS top-attack guided missile.
  • Maritime & Gulf: Iran allows Hormuz passage only for select states (Russia, India, China). Prince Sultan strike damaged a US E-3 Sentry AWACS (major capability hit). Airports in Iran and Iraq reported closed.
  • Regional spillover: Reports of Iranian strike destroying a warehouse in Dubai linked to anti-drone systems. Kuwait airport radar damaged by multiple drone strikes. Iraqi Shiite militia HQ struck; casualties reported.
  • Politics / negotiations: US announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iranian energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8PM ET), claiming talks “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. First pause was violated earlier.
  • Israeli defense minister says strikes on Beirut will continue until Hezbollah disarms.
  • 🟢 Good News: Multiple incoming missiles/UAVs intercepted today. No reported large-scale Israeli territorial breaches.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — strikes and counterstrikes continue across multiple fronts; pauses fragile.

  • ים ומפרץ: איראן מאפשרת מעבר בהורמוז רק למדינות נבחרות (רוסיה, הודו, סין). בפגיעת פרינס סלטן נפגע מטוס AWACS מסוג E-3 Sentry – אובדן כושר משמעותי. נמלי תעופה באיראן ובעיראק דיווחו כבסגורים.
  • הסלמה אזורית: דיווחים על הריסה של מאגר בדובאי שקשור למערכות נגד־מל"טים. שדה התעופה בכווית נפגע מרב־התקפות מל"טים; מטה מיליציה שיעית בעיראק הותקף עם הרוגים.

  • שר הביטחון הישראלי: תקיפות בביירות יימשכו עד פירוז חזבאללה.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: מערכות ההגנה האווירית יירטו בהצלחה שיגורים כנגד ישראל היום.
  • הערכת איום: בעלייה — הסלמה ורבת־חזיתית; הפסקות זמניות בסיכון גבוה.

Situation Brief — Last 48 hrs

Active: Heavy IAF/US strikes on Tehran (multiple sites including research facility and Natural Resources & Watershed Mgmt). Reports of damage at Mehrabad airport and civilian casualties.

  • Air / ISR losses — IRGC claims it shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper over Shiraz (possible Majid SHORAD). CENTCOM says Prince Sultan strike damaged an E-3 Sentry. Tactical: US ISR degraded; AWACS damage reduces regional C2.
  • Northern Border — Hezbollah — Daily activity. Hezbollah struck an IDF Merkava in Debel with an Iranian-made ALMAS top-attack ATGM. Continued cross-border fire and strikes on Lebanese infrastructure.
  • Red Sea / Houthis / Hormuz — Houthis launched 2 missiles + 1 UAV toward Israel; all intercepted. Houthi UAV also intercepted over Eilat. Iran allowing Strait of Hormuz passage only for selected states (Russia/India/China).
  • Regional fronts — Reported IRGC strike on warehouse in Dubai tied to foreign anti-drone systems (Fars). Kuwait airport radar damaged by repeated drone strikes. Airstrikes in Iraq killed militia members.
  • Operations scale — CENTCOM claims >11,000 combat flights, ~11,000 targets struck, 150+ vessels damaged/destroyed since campaign start.
  • Diplomacy / Pauses — US announced second 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes to Apr 6 (Trump: "talks going very well"); Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Note: first 5-day pause was violated hours after announcement.
  • Civilian & infrastructure — Commercial damage reported (Emirates Global Aluminium). Multiple civilian casualties in Tehran strikes reported.
  • 🟢 Good News — Multiple incoming missiles/UAVs successfully intercepted (including over Eilat). Air defenses functioning.
Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • גבול צפוני — חיזבאללה — פעילות יומיומית. פגיעה במשוריין מרכבה בדבל באמצעות טיל מסלול עליון איראני־ALMAS.
